summary: A dispatched lane executes its step as a derived workflow actor, recorded by the dispatch operation from the lane identity, the attempt, and the authenticated host, and pinned by the worker.dispatched fold as the instance's executing actor. accept_worker_result keeps its CD-0013 D5 comparison and now compares the owner against the party that executed, so a completed lane result is acceptable by the owner and by no one the lane identity itself covers. Pre-v4 dispatches replay unchanged and pin no actor.
title: the dispatched lane is the step's executing actor
